svg.title: Movement disorders with normal power: a cerebellar lesion lets movement start but makes it inaccurate, on the same side, with the subdivision deciding the signs; a basal ganglia imbalance either blocks starting (Parkinson disease, hypokinetic) or releases unwanted movement (chorea, hyperkinetic); each column gives the signs and the circuit that failed

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Abnormal movement, power NORMAL: cerebellum or basal ganglia?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: both are SIDE LOOPS: cortex → loop → thalamus → cortex · both also project to the brainstem

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: no upper motor neurons of their own, so NOT an upper motor neuron disorder

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cerebellum: corrects errors + learns skills · basal ganglia: release wanted, suppress unwanted movement

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: CEREBELLUM: movement starts, but is INACCURATE

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: signs on the SAME side as the lesion

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: the REPAIR SHOP: masks lesions elsewhere · its own lesions last

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: BASAL GANGLIA: release vs suppress is off

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: globus pallidus fires at rest → inhibits thalamus

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: dopamine: direct pathway UP, indirect DOWN

svg.text: • same circuit in every zone · half the brain's neurons

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • mossy → parallel fibres → Purkinje: weak, wide (~200,000 per cell)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Purkinje cells INHIBIT deep nuclei: the ONLY output

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • climbing fibre = error signal: teacher · parallel fibre = student

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • adjusts vestibulo-ocular reflex gain (aging, new glasses)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • cerebellar patient + prisms: NO adaptation, no after-effect

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • out: globus pallidus → thalamus → motor cortex

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • direct: striatum inhibits pallidus → DISINHIBITS thalamus →

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • indirect: extra pallidal synapse + subthalamic loop → inhibits

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • pars reticulata → superior colliculus: eye movements
